Rule

Eco vouchers in Belgium are capped at €250 per full-time employee per year and are exempt from social security and tax when granted under a sector or company agreement.

They are valid for 24 months and can only be spent on ecological products and services.

Steps in eBlox

Open the client, go to Benefits > Eco vouchers, set the annual amount and the reference period.

Run the annual order in June and send the order file to the voucher provider before the 15th.

title: SAP HCM time file – Colruyt import specification

storage.value:
File

Colruyt delivers worked days and absences from SAP HCM as a pipe-separated file COL_TIME_YYYYMM.txt on the SFTP drop before the 20th of each month.

Each line holds employee number, date, hours worked, absence code and cost centre.

Mapping

Absence codes map to eBlox through table INT-MAP-12; unknown codes are rejected and listed in the import report.
